derivation: probably from H5062 (נָגַף) (through the idea of impending); a cover or heap; i.e.
def: (only plural) wings of an army, or crowds of troops

words.word: upon him and upon his bands

occurrences.text: And I will scatter toward every wind all that are about him to help him, and all his bands; and I will draw out the sword after them.
And all his fugitives with all his bands shall fall by the sword, and they that remain shall be scattered toward all winds: and ye shall know that I the Lord have spoken it.
Gomer, and all his bands; the house of Togarmah of the north quarters, and all his bands: and many people with thee.
Thou shalt ascend and come like a storm, thou shalt be like a cloud to cover the land, thou, and all thy bands, and many people with thee.

And I will plead against him with pestilence and with blood; and I will rain upon him, and upon his bands, and upon the many people that are with him, an overflowing rain, and great hailstones, fire, and brimstone.
words: upon him and upon his bands

occurrences.text: Thou shalt fall upon the mountains of Israel, thou, and all thy bands, and the people that is with thee: I will give thee unto the ravenous birds of every sort, and to the beasts of the field to be devoured.
